fn_title.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_title() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RETURN NEW.title IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.title; END $$;

fn_body.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_body() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RETURN NEW.body IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.body; END $$;

fn_touch_orders.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_touch_orders() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN PERFORM fn_touch_orders(); RETURN NEW; END $$;

fn_touch_invoices.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_touch_invoices() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN PERFORM fn_touch_invoices(); RETURN NEW; END $$;

fn_sql_copy.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_sql_copy() RETURNS integer LANGUAGE sql AS $$ BEGIN RETURN 1; END $$;

fn_plpgsql_copy.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_plpgsql_copy() RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RETURN 1; END $$;

fn_semi_a.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_semi_a() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'a; b'; RETURN NULL; END $$;

fn_semi_b.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_semi_b() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'c'; RETURN NULL; END $$;

fn_audit(integer).definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_audit(integer) RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RETURN NEW; END $$;

fn_audit(text).definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_audit(text) RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RETURN NEW; END $$;

fn_dollar_a.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_dollar_a() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $fn$ BEGIN RETURN $$hello$$; END $fn$;

fn_dollar_b.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_dollar_b() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $fn$ BEGIN RETURN $$hello$$; END $fn$;

fn_nolang_a.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_nolang_a() RETURNS void AS $$ BEGIN RETURN 7; END $$;

fn_nolang_b.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_nolang_b() RETURNS void AS $$ BEGIN RETURN 7; END $$;

fn_reject_mutation.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_reject_mutation() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION '% is immutable', TG_TABLE_NAME; END $$;

fn_flow_if.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_flow_if() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN IF NEW.id IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $$;

fn_flow_case.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_flow_case() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN CASE WHEN NEW.id IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL; ELSE RETURN NEW; END CASE; END $$;

fn_bad.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_bad() RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unterminated $$;

fn_nobody.definition: CREATE FUNCTION fn_nobody() RETURNS void LANGUAGE sql
